Presets

Ready-made rules, so adding one does not start with writing a regex.

A preset is metadata plus a criterion, and the two come from different places on purpose. The name and description are prose, and no manifest has anywhere to put them. The pattern is taken from the manifest rather than copied beside it — a second copy of a regex is a second copy that can drift.

The join is by example: a preset names a string its matcher must claim, and the matcher is selected by running the manifest's own patterns against it. If nothing claims the example, or more than one thing does, the preset is not offered rather than shipping a pattern nobody vouches for. Each entry below shows the pattern that join actually resolved.

Issue keys in output text

jira-issue-keys · jira

Turns a bare issue key printed by a build or a commit message into a hoverable link

claims

CAB-8209

with

\b(?<key>[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}-\d{1,7})\b

Issue links link

jira-issue-links · jira

Jira issue URLs, the /browse/ form

claims

https://example.atlassian.net/browse/CAB-8209

with

^https?://[^/]+/browse/(?<key>[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+)

Pull request links link

github-pull-requests · github

GitHub pull request URLs

claims

https://github.com/aylith-labs/lintel/pull/12

with

^https://github\.com/(?<owner>[^/]+)/(?<repo>[^/]+)/(?<ispull>pull)/(?<number>\d+)

Issue links link

github-issues · github

GitHub issue URLs

claims

https://github.com/aylith-labs/lintel/issues/12

with

^https://github\.com/(?<owner>[^/]+)/(?<repo>[^/]+)/(?<isissue>issues)/(?<number>\d+)

Commit links link

github-commits · github

GitHub commit URLs

claims

https://github.com/aylith-labs/lintel/commit/c79ccc1f0a7d4e2b1c3f5a6d8e9b0c1d2e3f4a5b

with

^https://github\.com/(?<owner>[^/]+)/(?<repo>[^/]+)/commit/(?<sha>[0-9a-f]{7,40})

Pull requests and issues as repo#number text

github-repo-number · github

Matches repo#number in output and resolves it against the candidate owners

claims

terminal#18920

with

^(?<repo>[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)#(?<number>\d+)

Message links link

slack-messages · slack

Slack permalinks, including a link into a thread

claims

https://myteam.slack.com/archives/C01234ABCD/p1712345678000100

with

^https://(?<workspace>[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)\.slack\.com/archives/(?<channel>[A-Z0-9]+)/p(?<tsSeconds>\d{10})(?<tsMicros>\d{6})(?:\?thread_ts=(?<thread>\d+\.\d+))?

Session links link

stith-session-uris · stith

stith:// links to an agent session

claims

stith://session/1a2b3c4d-5e6f

with

^stith://session/(?<id>[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,64})

Web links link

stith-web-links · stith

Links to a session on the stith web UI

claims

https://stith.lvh.me/agent/1a2b3c4d-5e6f

with

^https?://[^/]+/(?:s|agent|sessions|embed/s)/(?<id>[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,64})

Agent session ids in output text

stith-session-ids · stith

A bare session id printed with no scheme and no link around it, which is how one usually appears

claims

ce786f3f-6fdc-4165-b9bd-20ff858844db

with

\b(?<id>[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})\b

Pane ids in output text

shefrd-pane-ids · shefrd

A multiplexer pane address like w1N:p39; opening one focuses that pane

claims

w1N:p39

with

\b(?<pane>w[123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ0]+:p[123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ0]+)\b

Git: Commit hashes in output text

git-commit-hashes · standalone

Abbreviated or full hashes printed by git -- hoverable, and a place to hang a custom action

claims

c79ccc1f0a7d4e2b1c3f5a6d8e9b0c1d2e3f4a5b

with

\b(?=[0-9a-f]*[a-f])[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b

Media: Images, audio and video link

media-files · standalone

Links and paths that resolve to a media file

claims

/home/steve/captures/screenshot.png

by

matched by file type — media

Source code files link

source-code-files · standalone

Local paths to a source file

claims

/home/steve/projects/lintel/presets.json

by

matched by file type — sourceCode

Built from the repo at aylith-labs/lintel — every page on this site is rendered from those files, so it cannot disagree with them.
